paragraphs.text: A lightweight DSH plugin for viewing OpenCode Go usage in the composer dock and Settings.
# OpenCode Go Usage
English | 中文

A lightweight DSH plugin built for one job: showing your **OpenCode Go** usage.
It adds one pill to

the composer dock and one page to Settings — no other surface,
no dependencies, no build step.
## What it shows

- **Composer dock** — a compact `Go [bar] 5h 13%` pill, left of the Turn-count
pill. The bar can be

hidden, the level it tracks (`5h` / week / month) is
configurable, and it can rotate between levels

on a timer.
- **Hover, click or focus** opens a panel with all three allowances: one bar each,
used

percentage, reset countdown, a manual refresh, and the bar / level / rotation
controls. Changes are

saved in the browser.
- **Settings → OpenCode Go** — three cards. Opening it reuses the cache instea

d of
querying again, then it refreshes every 60s; the button is there for an immediate read.
- **Bil

ingual** — the UI follows the Harness app language (Chinese and English
dictionaries are both regist

** — the UI follows the Harness app language (Chinese and English
dictionaries are both registered).
## Install

The repository is itself an installable bundle (`package.json` declares
`dsh.bundle`). Point the Har

ness plugin manager at this directory or the GitHub
repository. After installing, reload the page: t

he `Go` pill appears under the
composer and an "OpenCode Go" section appears in Settings.

Requires DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x (the `dsh.client`, `ctx.slots` and `ctx.locale`
contracts).
## Where the API key comes from
Resolved per request, in this order — no key needs to be written into the plugin:

1. `config.apiKey` on the plugin row, if set.
2. The credential behind `config.apiKeyEnv` (default `

OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`) — the
same key the Models page stores for the `opencode-go` provider.
3. A pro
cess environment variable of that name.
## Configuration
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`level` also accepts `week`/`w`/`周` and `month`/`m`/`月`; anything unknown falls back
to `rolling`. C

hanges require reloading the Harness (restart the app or re-enable
the bundle).
## Refresh and caching
| Surface | Request | Behaviour |
| Dock pill | `GET /dsh-opencode-go/usage` | Every 60s; served from the host cache while it is fresh

|
| Panel "Refresh" | `GET …?refresh=1` | Skips the cache, queries upstream |
| Settings opened | `

GET …?cache=1` | Uses whatever is cached, even if old; queries only when nothing was cached |
| Sett

ings open | `GET /dsh-opencode-go/usage` | Every 60s, same rhythm as the dock |
| Settings "Refresh"
| `GET …?refresh=1` | Queries upstream immediately |

A credential change (`credentials/reference-updated`) drops the cache, so a new key
is read on the n
ext request instead of showing the previous account's numbers.
## HTTP route
`GET /dsh-opencode-go/usage` (`?refresh=1` forces, `?cache=1` cache-only):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Failures return `{ "ok": false, "error": { "code": "NO_KEY|UNAUTHORIZED|FORBIDDEN|TIMEOUT|NETWORK|UP
STREAM|SHAPE", "message": "…" } }`.
## Notes

- The plugin reads `https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage` with the key you already
stored. The key ne

ver reaches the page: the browser only receives percentages
and reset times.
- The readings are the

provider's own integers. The Console page can differ by one
percentage point; the panel says so.
- T

he route is a read-only same-origin GET and does not pass the Harness browser
login gate. Harness li

stens on loopback by default; if you expose it to a LAN or
a tunnel, this route becomes reachable to

o.
- Bar colours use the theme tokens (`--dsw-alias-*`), so light and dark themes both
apply.
